title: Exempt the ezm8 second root commit in the history check
summary: Add the full id of the parentless second root 64ecdc9aa4fd24cbe4d4884c864d7e9041585c3d to [history] exempt in athena.toml, so athena check --history passes. I assume the queued fix tpkz lands first, and I leave CI and gate code alone.

defaults_applied.how: One-line config change; the gate fix stays in its own queued job.
The exemption is enforced by the history check, and the config parser requires a full commit id.
Verification runs athena check --history on the real history.
The commit id and the file to edit came from the request and athena.toml.

assumptions: The queued fix 20261010-163553-tpkz lands before this job is dispatched, so an exempt entry added later takes effect; this job does not reimplement it.
The whole change is adding one full commit id to [history] exempt in athena.toml.
The exempt entry must name a commit already in history when added; 64ecdc9 is on main, so it qualifies.
If tpkz has not landed, the check will still fail and the verifier should report that rather than the producer altering gate code.
question: Has the queued fix 20261010-163553-tpkz landed on main? I assumed it has. If not, this job can't make the history check pass.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml's [history] exempt list keeps 49c6ac1524677b8091081115fb5d410ed6d2b2ea and adds the full 40-character id 64ecdc9aa4fd24cbe4d4884c864d7e9041585c3d, with a comment saying it is a parentless second root Athena wrote during job ezm8.
Only athena.toml (and optionally CHANGELOG.md) change; no CI workflow, .gitattributes, or other governance file is touched.
Run `cargo run -- check --history` (or the repository's built athena binary via cargo run) from the root: it reports no violations, and 64ecdc9 is no longer flagged.
`cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, and `cargo fmt --all --check` pass, including the config test that exempt entries are full commit ids.

departures: The change is one line, but the history check depends on the unlanded tpkz fix, so verification may fail on ordering.
